purpose: Resolve failed eigenfunction/product references without changing the frozen sparse policies, profiles, physical grids, or original independent counts.
diagnosis: The 128/192 pycnocline solves differ by 2.17e-4 in the required positive mode/derivative norm and about 8.9e-3 in normalized product references. A 192/256 diagnostic reduces the mode/derivative discrepancy below 5.2e-7; 256/384 is no better. Use the first converged pair and independently refine quadrature.
followupRole: A separately declared resolution follow-up after both original pycnocline fixed-family configurations failed their strict Gram gates. It supplements, and does not replace, the original withheld cases. No selection rule or count margin is retuned.
